items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Sometimes referred to as an alley bow by rogues or ruffians, this small crossbow fires small bolts that are sometimes used to deliver poison to the target. It's small enough to be shot one-handed, but it still requires two hands to load.

items.name: Alchemical Grenade (Acid)
items.description: The grenadier carries 6 alchemical grenades that deal either acid, cold, or fire damage plus 2 persistent damage and 2 splash damage of the same type (typically two of each). The grenadier replenishes these each day using scavenged materials.

items.name: Alchemical Grenade (Cold)
items.description: The grenadier carries 6 alchemical grenades that deal either acid, cold, or fire damage plus 2 persistent damage and 2 splash damage of the same type (typically two of each). The grenadier replenishes these each day using scavenged materials.

items.name: Alchemical Grenade (Fire)

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

items.name: Alchemist's Toolkit
items.description: This mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks. If you wear your alchemist's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

generalAbilities.name: Alchemical Grenades
generalAbilities.description: The grenadier carries 6 alchemical grenades that deal either acid, cold, or fire damage plus 2 persistent damage and 2 splash damage of the same type (typically two of each). The grenadier replenishes these each day using scavenged materials.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cheek Pouches
offensiveAbilities.description: A ratfolk grenadier has stretchy cheek pouches that can store up to 1 cubic foot of objects (though no more than 4 light items). The ratfolk can remove or store an item using the Interact action. As long as the ratfolk has at least one object in their cheek pouches, their speech is noticeably difficult to understand.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Grenadier
offensiveAbilities.description: The ratfolk grenadier draws an alchemical grenade with an Interact action and throws it as a ranged Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Stow
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The ratfolk grenadier stores one held item of light or negligible Bulk in its cheek pouches.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming
offensiveAbilities.description: A ratfolk grenadier can end its movement in the same square as an ally that also has this ability. Only two such creatures can share the same space.
